Signed Contents offsets are allowed when looping is disabled, including bounded sections. A bounded section stores its absolute media origin separately from its signed section-relative offset; disabled bounded sections pre-roll before the section and play it once, while looped sections require nonnegative offsets and wrap within the section. Schema 50 converts schema-49 absolute bounded offsets and keeps the compatibility mirror. Absolute Set → Contents is implemented for Audio, looped MIDI, and non-loop MIDI: looped MIDI wraps source phase; non-loop MIDI stores a positive source offset for targets before the item and rebases events/source length for targets after it. Audio and MIDI edits commit atomically for supported selections. MIDI Contents Nudge wraps loop-source offsets and preserves item bounds. For non-loop MIDI, event movement clamps at source PPQ zero and any remaining leftward displacement advances the positive source offset; the MIDI source shrinks only by the applied event shift. Snap state, tempo-map conversion, source sections, and Undo/Redo must match REAPER.
